generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Bidders are bond the guidelines / instructions issued time to from the government
Final bill will be admitted only after the submission of 3rd party report handing over certificate and completion report
If any date in the tender time table is government holidays, nest working date will be considered
Corrigendums / modifications / correction if any will be published in the website only
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP portal
The Employer reserves the rights to reject any of all tenders without assigning any reason
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: The Tenderer shall have valid class - IV KPWD
In any TWO financial year out of last 5 financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26 Turn over Certificate Certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN Number compulsory
As prime contractor at least one similar work such as of value not less than 50 percentage of amount put tender last 5 financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26not below rank of Executive Engineer
Assessed available tender capacity computed as per the formula in section 3.6
after reading the terms and conditions as per the bid documents. submit the bidders declaration on a letterhead

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Rejuvenation and Repairs of 5 Nos OHTs at various villages in Sedam Taluka under EAP 4215-01-102-2-04-132 2026-27

itemList.description: Work 1: Rejuvenation and Repairs of 50 KL OHT at Buragapalli Village in Sedam Taluka (A.A. Sl. 11) - Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Super structures of building , Road works, Water works, Irrigation works and super structure works of bridges upto 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators. The cost includes all lead and lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes , labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. [Com-Vol-1 SR/I.No.2.5.2/Pg.no.16]

Cleaning of Water Storage Tank or Sump by following method: (1) Empty the Tank/ Sump and make it to near dry, (2) Apply blEaching powder uniformally ( at Tank capacity x 0.5 gms/litre) inside the Tank/ Sump and wait for one hour, (3) After one hour, clean/ rinse the Tank/ Sump with fresh water. Repeat the process (2) and (3) for two to three times, all complete, as directed by the Engineer-in-charge. [Com-VolI-5 SR/I.No 18.4/Pg.no.221]

Food Graded Water Proofing Membrane Providing and laying water proofing treatment to the Water tanks and Liquid Retaining structures with two component acrylic polymer modified cementitious waterproofing membrane with minimum elongation of 50% applied at 1.5 kg/m2 for internal side waterproofing in two layers with waiting period of 4-6 hrs per layer and food grade epoxy coating in two coats certified by CFTRI Mysuru, including surface preparation completely as per specification. [Com-VolI-I SR/I.No 15.6/Pg.no.150]

Ladder inside the container: Providing anodized aluminium ladder using 65mm x 32mm x 3.0mm C section for ladder side channel x 25mm dia., flutal pipe for Rungs at 250mm c/c ladder fixed at an angle of 70 degrees to horizontal including necessary 25mm dia., G.I. shutters with necessary G.I. fasteners for bracing the ladders to the Tank walls to prevent buckling of the ladder with necessary (M-15) bed for embedding the ladder bottom complete [Com-Vol-5 SR/I.No 7.12.1/Pg.no.88]

Providing and fixing MS inspection door of size 60 cms x 60 cms, including MS frame made of 50x50x6mm angle, shutters made of 3mm thick MS sheets, with hinges, locking arrangements at top etc. including painting with anticorrosive approved paint etc. complete including all lead and lifts etc. [Com-Vol-5 SR/I.No 7.3/Pg.no.85]

Supplying and fixing 40mm dia. GI pipe medium duty pipes hand railing 3 rows fixed to RCC 1:2:4 vibrated post of 150x150mm at bottom and 100x150mm at top, placed at 2 Mtrs. intervals for a height of 750mm including curing, painting GI pipes with two coats of anticorrosive steel paint over a primer coat etc. with all lead lift etc. (The rate per meter is for 3 rows of GI pipes and RCC post) [Com-Vol-5 SR/I.No 7.12.1/Pg.no.88]

Finishing walls with water proofing cement paint of required shade :Old work (one coats applied at 2.20 kg/10 m2) over priming coat of primer applied at 0.80 l/10 m2 complete including cost of Priming coat including preparing the surface after thoroughly cleaning the surface to remove all dirt, dust and foreign matter, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge. [Com 2023-24-Vol-II SR/I.No.8.72.1/Pg.no.52]

Providing plastering in CM 1:3 proportion after removing old plaster of existing RCC over head tanks, including smooth finishing, minimum 2% of approved quality water proofing compound, curing, scaffolding and giving satisfactory water proof testing as per direction etc. complete with all lead lifts etc. for side walls, shell portions, bottom doom, bottom slab and ribs etc. for: 12mm thick for exposed surfaces 9.0 to 12.0 m staging. [Com-SR 2021-22/I.No.18.3/Pg.no.113]

Providing and fixing RCC final and ventilators as per approved design and specifications with form works and protected with wire mesh. The plinth to be of RCC circular pillars and canopy with an ornamental finish at top. The first 22.5 cms height to be covered with RCC panelling as per detailed drawings etc. with all lead and lifts and excluding reinforcement of Steel [Com-SR 2023-24/Vol-5/I.No.7.2/Pg.no.85]

PART-B : CONSTRUCTION OF VALVE CHAMBERS (2 Nos) - as per valve chamber sub-estimate - Earth work excavation by manual means for drains, canals, waste weir, draft,approach channels,keytrenches,foundation of Buildings and bridges and such simillar works in all kinds of soils, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, excavated surface leveled and sides neatly dressed disposing off the excavated stuff or sorting and stacking the selected stuff for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools and other appurtenaces required to complete the work.. In all kinds of soils Depth upto 1.5 m [Com-Vol-1 SR/I.No1.4.1/Pg.no.5]

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Foundation works.The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregatesas per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers laid in finishedlayers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including all lead and lifts, costof all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes,labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates [Com-Vol-1 SR/I.No2.2.1/Pg.no.15]

Providing and fixing MS inspection door of size 60 frame made of 50x50x6mm angle, shutters made of 3mm thick MS sheets, with hinges, locking arrangements at top etc. including painting with anticorrosive approved paint etc. complete including all lead and lifts etc. [Com-Vol-5 SR/I.No 7.3/Pg.no.85]

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. [Com-Vol-I SR/I.No2.11h/Pg.no.18]
